text: Electrical Engineering and Its Automation is an undergraduate major in regular institutions of higher learning in China, belonging to the category of electrical engineering. The duration of study is four years, and it confers a Bachelor of Engineering degree. This major mainly studies related fields such as power electronics technology, automatic control technology, and computer technology, covering the design and manufacture of power equipment, the development of automatic control technology, and the maintenance of power systems. It is closely related to People's Daily lives and industrial production, and holds a crucial position in modern society.
